exposure: Endometrial preparation protocol (HMG, letrozole + HMG, HRT)
cohort: 2710 women with PCOS who underwent frozen embryo transfer (FET)
finding: In women with PCOS undergoing FET, ovarian stimulation protocols for endometrial preparation, especially letrozole + HMG, are associated with reduced risks of HDP and LGA compared to HRT cycles.
mod_finding: Ovarian stimulation protocols for endometrial preparation are associated with a reduced risk of cesarean delivery compared to HRT cycles.
